author: Elpelabraz
quote: The combat is beautiful. The story is really hard to follow, and progress can be a bit slow because it’s easy to get lost on the map, but the game is still a lot of fun.

author: Elpelabraz
quote: The story is good, and the graphics are good, but the game feels way too easy. I get that the original came out decades ago, but they didn’t take the time to improve the combat system. You could literally win fights with your hands tied behind your back.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Elpelabraz
quote: After 40 hours, I think the game is incredible. It has a lot in common with GTA V and RDR2, but it takes those ideas even further. The story starts off a little slow, but it does a great job of developing the characters. The world feels so alive, and the random events are great. I haven’t run into any bugs that affected my experience.
